hook: Us raat Geeta ne apni hi awaaz suni…
hook_text: Us raat Geeta ne apni hi awaaz suni…
feedback: Great use of the cold open and creepy atmosphere. The imagery is well-tailored to the Bundelkhand folk-horror vibe with the peepal tree bells and the reverse feet motif. To improve, ensure the emotional bond between Geeta and her family is felt a bit more strongly in the middle cuts before the tension peaks, and tighten the pacing of the silent cuts near the end for maximum heartbeat tension.
lines: Us raat Geeta ne apni hi awaaz suni…
Geeta apni saas ke sath baithkar soch rahi thi, beta, nayi saree pehnane ka.
Bundelkhand ke is chote gaon mein, chandni raat sannate se bhari thi.
Dadi ne dheere se samjhaya, beta, ye daayan ka chakkar mat lagao, yaar.
Raat ke do baje, bina hawa ke peepal ka ghanta baj utha.
Ghanti ki aawaz… aur dil tezi se dhadakne laga.
Geeta ka haath darwaze ki ghanti ki taraf badha.
Geeta chillane lagi, par gale se keval ghanti ki chhanchhan nikli.
Bahar khadi Daayan Geeta ki exact awaaz mein hansne lagi.
Geeta ki aankhon mein aansu the, aur muh se ek shabd nahi nikla.
Raat ko gate ki bell baje, toh wapas ring mat karna.
